root_dir.description: Root directory for BuildKit state and metadata.

cache_dir.description: Directory where BuildKit stores its cache data.

cache_size.description: Maximum cache size in bytes (0 = unlimited).

cache_disabled.description: Disable cache entirely (useful for ephemeral CI builders).

builders.description: List of named BuildKit builders for multi-platform support.

dns.description: Custom DNS servers to use inside build containers (e.g., ['8.8.8.8', '1.1.1.1']).

network_external.description: Allow builds to access external networks (disable for air-gapped environments).

registry_mirrors.description: Registry mirror definitions to accelerate image pulls.

http.description: Use HTTP instead of HTTPS for mirror communication.

tls.description: Enable TLS verification for mirror connections.

endpoints.description: Ordered list of mirror endpoint URLs (e.g., ['https://mirror.example.com']).

log_format.description: Format for build logs (text or JSON).

gc_enabled.description: Enable automatic garbage collection of unused build data.

gc_min_age.description: Minimum age of unused data before garbage collection (Go duration format).

gc_policies.description: Custom garbage collection policies (advanced). Each policy has a 'key' (e.g., 'ref') and 'rules' (e.g., [{key: 'ref', value: 'keep-last-5'}]).
